title: Sword and Shield
description: You're in. A recruit who has never been hit doesn't know how to hold a line, so five veterans will drill you until you do. The obstacle course after is the easy part.

objectives.description: Take the veterans' formation drills without breaking
Finish the obstacle course in Company time
Report to Captain Steele that the drills are done

notes: Threat: an untrained recruit gets someone else killed on a real contract (paying off mercenary_01's stated cost). Giver motive: Steele drills before he deploys, no exceptions. Consequence: this is training, so the worsening is deferred - it lands in mercenary_03 and mercenary_07 where the drilling either paid off or didn't.
